name: dreamedge
description: A framework for independently installable, AI-editable business apps
author: hongzhiyin

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:framework && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:desktop: node tests/desktop.e2e.mjs && node tests/multi-window.e2e.mjs && node tests/project-menu.e2e.mjs && node tests/sidebar.e2e.mjs && node --import tsx tests/dependency-sidebar.e2e.mjs && node tests/ai-sidebar.e2e.mjs && node --import tsx tests/chat-layout.e2e.mjs && node --import tsx tests/ai-structure.e2e.mjs && node tests/timeline.e2e.mjs && node --import tsx tests/chat-markdown.e2e.mjs && node tests/git-sidebar.e2e.mjs && node tests/project-root-ai.e2e.mjs && node tests/agent-git.e2e.mjs && node tests/export-app.e2e.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.build:framework: node scripts/check-framework-version.mjs && node scripts/build-sdk-source.mjs && node scripts/clean-sdk.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json && node scripts/build-framework.mjs && node scripts/pack-framework.mjs
